# Part 04 · Post-Training Alignment

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcRZlYTR_Hw/) · Published 20 Aug 2026

> Why does a freshly pretrained model answer a question with another question?

A base model learned to continue internet text. Ask it a question and it treats it like a quiz sheet and writes more questions.

## The idea

- Supervised fine-tuning wraps conversations in a chat template and computes loss only on the assistant's reply.
- Preference alignment (RLHF or DPO) teaches judgment by rewarding the preferred of two answers.
- Pretraining gives the model its knowledge. Post-training gives it the assistant's format and judgment.

## The formula

$$
\mathcal{L}_{\text{DPO}} = -\mathbb{E}\left[\log \sigma\left(\beta \log \frac{\pi_\theta(y_w \mid x)}{\pi_{\text{ref}}(y_w \mid x)} - \beta \log \frac{\pi_\theta(y_l \mid x)}{\pi_{\text{ref}}(y_l \mid x)}\right)\right]
$$
